channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: J&K Police file FIR over PDP’s Article 370 anniversary rally, party says ‘blatant misuse of power, authority’
item.description: The name of former J&K Chief Minister Mufti has been mentioned in the FIR for taking out a rally on August 4 and August 5 in the city, on the seventh anniversary of the abrogation of Article 370, “without prior police permission”

item.title: National Handloom Day: Inside the Bonda tribe’s enduring Ringa weaving tradition
item.description: On National Handloom Day, a look at how women of Odisha’s Bonda tribe continue to preserve the handwoven Ringa, a weave that defines their identity

item.title: The hands that are shaping Amaravati
item.description: As Andhra Pradesh’s greenfield capital takes shape, stories of migrant workers, women finding new livelihoods, and efforts to balance development with social and environmental concerns reveal the human side of building a new city. Their experiences shed a unique light on how an ambitious project is reshaping lives alongside the landscape of the capital region, writes P. Sujatha Varma

item.title: Karnataka’s rice bowl shows no signs of filling up
item.description: Deficit rain recorded in June and July because of El-Nino, impact of the West Asia war and some local factors in the rice growing areas have all pushed the price of various rice varieties, writes Rashmi Patil

item.title: In Telangana, property owners locked out of their own land
item.description: Several owners of legally purchased plots, houses and apartments across Telangana are finding themselves unable to sell, mortgage or transfer their properties after entire survey numbers containing prohibited categories such as Bhoodan, waqf, ceiling surplus and assigned lands were brought under the Section 22A prohibited list. But the Congress-led government says not one cent of land has been deliberately added to the list since it assumed office in December 2023. P. Laxma Reddy and M. Rajeev explore the ground situation

item.title: ED raids five locations in Bihar’s Muger in digital job scam
item.description: During the search operations, various incriminating documents about immovable property, bank account details, agreements, investment details, list of investors, etc were recovered and seized, which are being scrutinised to proceed further under the provisions of PMLA, 2002.

item.title: Ladakh body seeks withdrawal of cases, compensation to victims of 2025 violence
item.description: He said the public reaction to the Leh incident in the country could not evoke the same reaction as to the Delhi incident in spite of “Ladakhis being patriots of the country and fighting the enemies on the borders”.

item.title: J&K BJP distances itself from slogans, ‘berating Kashmir women’, during rally in Kashmir
item.description: Ruling National Conference said the apology tendered by the BJP spokesman “was not enough”

item.description: The north Andhra districts have recorded rain deficit, ranging between 40% and 60%

item.title: Justice for AgriGold victims brooks no delay, Naidu officials
item.description: The government will deal firmly with those trying to obstruct relief measures by approaching courts, he says, and instructs officials to speed up the auction of properties so that compensation can be disbursed to victims at the earliest

item.title: FCRA Bill is ‘religion-neutral’, Shah assures Christian bodies
item.description: Delegation meets Amit Shah; member says Home Minister has told them that the government has “no intention to harass the Christian community”; forum flags ‘deemed cessation of assets’ clause; Bill could be taken up for discussion in Parliament on August 12

item.title: CBI arrests four accused persons in tech-support fraud case
item.description: The CBI raided 10 locations across Punjab and Delhi, including a call centre operated from the premises of the main accused in Mohali in the intervening night of August 5 and 6

item.description: Announcing reopening of the application portal for three months from August 1, the government said the SRO rates prevailing prior to June 5 will apply

item.title: Collaboration, not blame game, needed to tackle floods, says Nagaland Minister
item.description: There are allegations that illegal mining activities in Nagaland contributed to the devastating floods in parts of Assam, claiming 95 lives so far

item.title: PM urges people to mark National Handloom Day
item.description: Posting on his Instagram account, Mr. Modi was seen handling various pieces of handloom material from different parts of the country

item.title: Government spent ₹557.51 crore in PM Modi’s 77 foreign visits: MEA in Rajya Sabha
item.description: These visits and subsequent MoUs helped in international partnerships 'across the sectors', says govt.

item.title: Bengal BJP fights against its ‘Trinamoolification’
item.description: Having coming to power in West Bengal earlier this year, the State unit of the BJP is facing a major political challenge, which party leaders are describing as its ‘Trinamoolification’. Implicit in this word is that several leaders from the Trinamool Congress are joining the party and being given key responsibilities, and that the BJP is embracing the very culture of the party it opposed and contested against, finds Shiv Sahay Singh

item.title: Rajya Sabha clears Appropriation Bill for expenditure of ₹54,067 crore
item.description: Centre has taken care of Kashmir’s financial needs, says Nirmala Sitharaman

item.title: DMK lays down conditions to support delimitation Bill
item.description: These conditions come amid renewed efforts from the Centre to reach out to the Opposition to secure numbers for the Bill; however, a top DMK leader says govt has not approached them yet

item.title: Starvation pushing mother to kill child a ‘collective failure’, says Gujarat High Court
item.description: Granting bail to Lakhiben Solanki, who has been in custody since her arrest in March, Justice Hasmukh D. Suthar said the incident should not be viewed solely as an individual crime but as a reflection of systemic shortcomings in ensuring access to basic necessities such as food, healthcare and dignity.

item.description: Justice Veerappa told The Hindu that he found several violations of guidelines with respect to core zone, buffer zone and periphery zone owing to the allowance of commercial activities and homestays in the prohibited area of the Hampi World Heritage Area.

Vanishing villages: from prosperity of migration, Kumbanad and other villages in Kerala’s Pathanamthitta fall to an uncertain future
item.description: A large number of villages in the central Travancore region are left to decay as many in the younger generation, settled abroad, are unwilling to return. Hiran Unnikrishnan takes a road trip through the near-abandoned villages and takes a look at the lives of the elders in the region

item.title: P.J. Kurien urges Speaker to ensure Home Minister’s presence in Lok Sabha
item.description: Veteran Congress leader says that he was disappointed over the 'non-functioning’ House and its ‘failure’ to ensure the accountability of the government and avoid the ‘consequent stalemate’

item.title: Post PCB consent, APMDC, JSW to fast-track iron ore mining in Prakasam district
item.description: The joint venture, in which JSW Steel holds 89%, will set up a beneficiation plant for 1.35 million tonnes a year of high grade concentrate; the Consent to Operate is awaited, and the project is likely to be operational by early 2028

item.title: House panel flags fertilizer shortage, calls for proper mechanism to address it
item.description: Centre’s responses to scarcity created by West Asia war were largely reactive, parliamentary panel says; it calls for a permanent joint fertilizer command and monitoring cell, to provide ‘continuous, real-time coordination’ on supply of fertilizers during every cropping season

item.title: Centre opposes pleas for income-based creamy layer in SC/ST quotas
item.description: Union government argues that judicial precedent has laid down creamy layer concept does not apply to SCs and STs; the majority of welfare schemes, except quota for education and State services, already have a means test ensuring ‘benefits of schemes percolate to those who actually deserve them’

item.title: Two women killed, 18 injured as speeding private bus collides with four vehicles near Kunnamkulam in Kerala’s Thrissur
item.description: Two people in critical condition. Deceased identified as Riya Fathima, 17, and Thankamani, 72
